subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class one-way A2A dispatch surface, and should it be a `sessions_send` mode/flags or a separate primitive?
rationale: This changes model-facing session-tool semantics and must preserve existing coordination workflows while giving handoff workflows a clean contract.

options.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
options.body: Add a named dispatch/handoff mode to the current session tool contract, keep conversation mode as the default, and cover both source-level and user-facing delivery behavior.

options.title: Add a separate primitive
options.body: Introduce a new `sessions_deliver` or `sessions_enqueue` style tool for one-way delivery, accepting the extra model-facing surface and docs burden.

options.title: Limit work to reverse-call guard
options.body: Land only the narrower reverse-call fix and leave dispatch-only handoffs without a first-class contract.

recommendation.title: Add explicit dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Add a named dispatch/handoff mode to the current session tool contract, keep conversation mode as the default, and cover both source-level and user-facing delivery behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The original A2A ping-pong feature and current sessions-send ownership trail point most strongly to this area owner for API direction.
